_readme: The Timeline's 'By group' view (timeline.html?order=groups). Rows are ordered so groups that combine sit next to each other. 'cells' are keyed by chapter slug (told order); a missing chapter means the group isn't in it. 'merged' groups replace their parts from 'from' onwards (shown as one card spanning the rows). 'events' are ids from content/timeline.json. 'moves' are members joining or leaving, with the book line. Text uses [[slug|label]] links. After a new chapter is published: add a cell per group, set 'asOf', and update each 'now'. Then run python3 build/build.py.

asOf.note: A ninth chapter has begun, but so far it is only a title. The last scene is the departure for the New Jersey system.

chris.place: The Reformed Travis Scott Sector (last trace)
chris.doing: Buying a McDouble from one of its planets and taking balling all for himself. Nobody has seen him since the 2007/2008 housing crash.

apart: The New Crips and the New Apple Employees are both after Chris, but they haven't met. The Prophecy's phone needs the 3 year contract plan from Verizon (the New Apple Employees have it), Facebook (Pre-Cringe) (the New Crips are going for it) and Snapchat: Ghost Protocol (said to be in Freddy Fazbear's Pizza). Walter and Jesse have left the New Apple Employees to cook in Scott the Woz's basement.
